comparison_method: Fetched the official PDF to a temporary file and compared complete pdftotext -layout output byte-for-byte with the local copy; no source file replaced.
established_fact: On the recorded retrieval date, the NIED New Curriculum catalogue linked the 2018 edition; its complete extracted layout text matched the local working copy. This is a dated observation, not a statement of 2026 cohort validity.
limits: A live catalogue link does not itself establish that this cohort has no separate examination amendment or instruction. No cohort-specific 2026 confirmation was found in the inspected sources. Search absence is not proof of no amendment.

local_origin: Manually added, as stated in operator-forwarded review feedback; no matching harvest entry. Original acquisition date, original download URL and person who added it are not established. Publisher URL retrieved today is verification evidence, not original acquisition provenance.
modification_content_caveat: Historical content changes remain unestablished; no independently archived 2018 baseline was compared. Current complete extracted text is equal and all 52 page images are pixel-identical at 144 dpi. Hidden PDF structures and cohort validity are outside this comparison.

publisher_reupload_inference.statement: The most likely explanation of the publisher HTTP Last-Modified of 17 May 2024 alongside PDF CreationDate/ModDate of September 2018 is re-uploading or server-side copying of the existing document with unchanged text.
basis: Publisher PDF CreationDate and ModDate remain September 2018
Current publisher/local complete extracted layout text is identical
publisher_reupload_inference.limit: Inference only. No NIED confirmation or archived 2018 snapshot comparison; neither HTTP Last-Modified nor present text equality proves a historical event or cohort validity.

binary_difference_explanation.observed: Publisher Producer is Microsoft Word 2010, size 979057 bytes; local Producer is macOS Quartz PDFContext, size 1000664 bytes. ModDate metadata and encoded binary structure also differ.
binary_difference_explanation.inference: A local re-save/reprocessing is the likely cause of the changed binary. Producer/metadata/encoding differences explain how hashes can differ with equal extracted text.
binary_difference_explanation.limit: Exact processing sequence and actor unknown; this is separate from inferred publisher re-upload.
